year.era: Drop each artist into the decade they won the Grammy for Best New Artist.
year.shot: In what year did {label} win the Grammy for Best New Artist?

rows.label: Olivia Rodrigo
rows.hook: topped the charts with a heartbroken ballad about a driver's license

rows.label: Dua Lipa
rows.hook: is a pop star behind the dance hit "Levitating" and the album Future Nostalgia

rows.label: The Beatles
rows.hook: were the Liverpool foursome of Lennon, McCartney, Harrison and Starr who led the British Invasion

rows.label: Billie Eilish
rows.hook: whispers moody pop hits like "Bad Guy" and records with her songwriting brother

rows.label: Tom Jones
rows.hook: is a Welsh voice behind "It's Not Unusual" and "She's a Lady"

rows.label: Amy Winehouse
rows.hook: sang "Rehab" with a beehive hairdo and a retro soul sound

rows.label: Mariah Carey
rows.hook: is a five-octave-range diva known for "Vision of Love" and a holiday classic about Christmas wishes

rows.label: Adele
rows.hook: is a powerhouse vocalist behind "Rolling in the Deep" and "Hello"

rows.label: Christina Aguilera
rows.hook: rose from a Mickey Mouse Club stint to sing "Genie in a Bottle" and judge a TV singing contest

rows.label: Chappell Roan
rows.hook: is a drag-inspired pop star known for "Pink Pony Club" and "Good Luck, Babe!"

rows.label: Cyndi Lauper
rows.hook: sang "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" and "Time After Time" with brightly dyed hair

rows.label: Evanescence
rows.hook: blended gothic metal with a piano hook on the single "Bring Me to Life"

rows.label: Sheryl Crow
rows.hook: is a rocker who sang "All I Wanna Do" and "If It Makes You Happy"

rows.label: Bette Midler
rows.hook: is "The Divine Miss M", who sang "Wind Beneath My Wings" and starred in Beaches

rows.label: Carrie Underwood
rows.hook: won a TV singing competition, then scored country hits like "Before He Cheats"

rows.label: Lauryn Hill
rows.hook: left the Fugees to release The Miseducation, a landmark album of hip-hop and soul

rows.label: LeAnn Rimes
rows.hook: was a teenage country prodigy who sang "How Do I Live" and "Blue"

rows.label: Sam Smith
rows.hook: sang the heartbroken ballad "Stay With Me" and later "Unholy" with Kim Petras

rows.label: Alicia Keys
rows.hook: is a pianist-singer known for "Fallin'" and the hit "Empire State of Mind" with Jay-Z

rows.label: Carly Simon
rows.hook: sang the mysterious hit "You're So Vain" and the Bond theme "Nobody Does It Better"

rows.label: Norah Jones
rows.hook: sold millions with the smooth jazz-pop album Come Away with Me and the song "Don't Know Why"

rows.label: Bob Newhart
rows.hook: is a deadpan comedian famous for a one-sided telephone routine and the sitcom about a Chicago psychologist

rows.label: Megan Thee Stallion

rows.label: Tracy Chapman
rows.hook: sang the acoustic hits "Fast Car" and "Give Me One Reason"

rows.label: Macklemore & Ryan Lewis

rows.label: Bobby Darin
rows.hook: was a crooner famous for "Mack the Knife" and "Beyond the Sea"

rows.label: Maroon 5

rows.label: Meghan Trainor

rows.label: Sheena Easton
rows.hook: got her start on a TV documentary and sang "9 to 5" and the Bond theme "For Your Eyes Only"

rows.label: John Legend
rows.hook: is a pianist-singer known for "All of Me" and "Ordinary People"

rows.label: Christopher Cross
rows.hook: sang the soft rock yacht anthems "Sailing" and "Ride Like the Wind"

rows.label: Sade

rows.label: Toni Braxton

rows.label: Bobbie Gentry

rows.label: Men at Work

rows.label: Paula Cole

rows.label: Culture Club

rows.label: Jody Watley
rows.hook: left the group Shalamar to sing "Looking for a New Love" as a solo star

rows.label: Arrested Development
rows.hook: is an alt hip-hop group known for "Tennessee" and "Mr. Wendal"
